calibration.candidate_transfer: clipped standard sRGB encoding of scene-linear reference RGB times one scalar gain; a hypothesis about engine display, not a verified native color pipeline
calibration.fit: For LV8, LV10, LV12 only, match the mean RGB8 of fit_back by scalar gain via 64 bisection steps in log2 gain [-20,20]. Fit log2(gain) = slope * native_LV + intercept by ordinary least squares. No per-channel fit or image alignment.
calibration.freeze: All held-out intensity and spatial-patch checks use the two fitted coefficients unchanged. The first capture per case is used; LV10 repeats only measure variation.

scope: Calibration diagnostic before an Enfusion appearance pair; no model fitting, renderer-buffer access or live rendering. The multibounce output is a synthetic transport illustration using the same frozen display mapping.
limits: Night environment and reflection probes remain active in Enfusion; the off case measures only their display response
Enfusion light radius controls influence while Cycles emitter radius controls source size; no equality between these quantities
Light LV, material BRDF and color transfer remain uncalibrated until independent checks pass
Earlier geometry export normal/UV precision failures remain retained
This diagnostic scene and all its settings have been inspected; they do not replace an untouched model test
